full_name: Denise Brennan | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Denise Brennan is an anthropologist who writes about border militarization, worker exploitation and trafficking, worker-led organizing, and climate change. At Radcliffe, she will write an ethnographic book on shifting labor conditions on a heating planet.
